name: Hen xao
summary: Hến xào is stir-fried clam, sweet and salty with chili, finished with crushed roasted peanuts and eaten with crisp grilled rice paper. It is a Hội An plate.
origin: Hội An. The plate can still stop someone who has come to Da Nang.
taste: The clam is sweet and salty, with chili, against the cracker.
howToEat: Eat the stir-fried clam with the crisp grilled rice paper. Bánh đập, the cracker clapped to a warm steamed sheet, is the partner on this plate.

The Hoi An World Heritage conservation centre’s 30 October 2024 note concentrates the snack in Cẩm Nam. Its 4 December 2025 article stir-fries the clams with fried shallot and rau răm and dips the plate in mắm nêm. Its 4 September 2024 article, republishing Dân Việt, adds onion, peanuts, and chili sauce, eaten with bánh đa or bánh đập and a sweet-sour dip.
